title: Mobile channel image viewer has no back/close affordance
summary: Owner reported that tapping an image in an installed mobile app opened a full-screen image with no way back to the thread, and suggested an in-app window with an X. Product Development Lead reported implementing an app-owned image modal with explicit X, backdrop close, and Escape/back cancellation for mobile and desktop renderers, with a regression test and mobile screenshot. Current HEAD main (b39dca3) includes the viewer implementation via integrated commit c62c5b6 and subsequent committed viewer refinements e36447d, 7e9d75b, b6455ea. The mobile screenshot artifact exists. Closed as implemented and integrated; release/runtime presence was not independently checked.
nextAction: None for this request; viewer implementation is in main. Existing thread reply reports focused tests, typecheck, invariant gates, and screenshot; no further verification requested.
